 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)

    ics = [c for r, c in cells if grid[r][c] == inner_color]
    t = min(min(irs) - r0, r1 - max(irs), min(ics) - c0, c1 - max(ics))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0-t), min(h, r1+t+1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0-t), min(w, c1+t+1)):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = inner_color
    return out
